n = int(input())
b = int(input())
numbers = list(map(int, input().split()))

if n % 2 == 1:
    print(0)
    exit()

diff_map = {}
even_count = 0
odd_count = 0

for i in range(n):
    if numbers[i] % 2 == 0:
        even_count += 1
    else:
        odd_count += 1
    if even_count > 0 and odd_count > 0 and even_count == odd_count and i + 1 < n:
        diff_map[i] = abs(numbers[i] - numbers[i + 1])

if not diff_map:
    print(0)
elif len(diff_map) == 1:
    val = next(iter(diff_map.values()))
    print(1 if val <= b else 0)
else:
    vals = sorted(diff_map.values())
    count = 0
    for v in vals:
        if v <= b:
            b -= v
            count += 1
        else:
            break
    print(count)
